messages:
olivia: Heads-up — after the RBAC delegated-admin rollout at 08:12 UTC we saw ~40 SCIM deprovisions come through for service accounts. KMS decrypt logs show repeated AccessDenied for key `redwood-scim`. Anyone touching KMS policies?
sam: saw that. I rolled the delegated-admin role mapping to include `scim:manage` at 08:10. Did we rotate the KMS alias earlier in the day?
maria: we rotated alias `redwood-scim` at 2023-11-14T02:30Z (automated rotation). IAM binding may not include the SCIM principal anymore. Looking.
kevin: if KMS decrypt fails SCIM may mark account as orphan and deprov. Are there errors in the audit log? sample: `projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...: PermissionDenied`
josh: copying logs — `scim-service` principal -> kms.decrypt missing. Quick fix: add member `serviceAccount:scim@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to cryptoKey IAM with role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`.
olivia: patch pushed to add binding. Does that require key rewrap? No, just IAM update. Rollout now?
maria: applied the IAM binding at 08:45 UTC. SCIM queue replay started. But we still have ~6 accounts in deprovisioned state that shouldn't be. Need manual reconcile.
devops-bot: incident created INC-2026-1218 by josh — priority P1 — SCIM mass deprovisioning. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/scim-deprov
kevin: also flag for vuln triage: someone with delegated-admin could craft requests to deprov if KMS access was removed. Not seeing signs of malicious calls in audit; requests came from `scim-service` only.
anjali: confirm audit entries: `principal=scim-service@... action=PATCH /scim/v2/Users` status=200 then later `DELETE` status=204. That sequence matches worker retries after decrypt fail; SCIM code tries to clean up on decryption failure.
sam: suggestions — 1) safer fallback in SCIM (don’t auto-delete on KMS failures), 2) add alert when >5 deprovs within 5m during RBAC or KMS rotation windows.
olivia: agreed. I'll open a PR to change behaviour and add the alert. Can we also add a post-mortem with root cause = KMS IAM binding missing after auto-rotation?
josh: adding to incident notes and paging relevant SREs. Quick mitigation for affected customers: re-provision accounts and enable manual approval flow for deprovs until rollout is hardened.
audit-bot: export created: bigquery.export=scim_deprov_incident_1699998888 for longterm audit and SIEM ingestion.
maria: follow-up action — add CI gate to the KMS rotation playbook that validates IAM bindings for all service principals referenced by SCIM/RBAC before rotation completes.
olivia: filing follow-ups: PR for SCIM fallback, alert playbook, CI check for KMS rotation. Will include timeline and list of impacted tenant IDs in the post-mortem.
